links.outcome: Share of hospitals using predictive models that locally evaluated them for accuracy
links.effect: 61 percent of hospitals using predictive models evaluated them for accuracy with local health system data; 79 percent of model users used EHR-developer models.
links.quote: Sixty-one percent of hospitals that used models evaluated them for accuracy using data from their health system (local evaluation), but only 44 percent reported local evaluation for bias.

links.outcome: Share of hospitals using predictive models that locally evaluated them for bias
links.effect: Only 44 percent of hospitals using predictive models reported local evaluation for bias, compared with 61 percent for accuracy.
links.quote: Sixty-one percent of hospitals that used models evaluated them for accuracy using data from their health system (local evaluation), but only 44 percent reported local evaluation for bias.

screen.reason: National survey (AHA IT supplement) examining hospital adoption, use cases, and local evaluation/governance practices for AI and predictive models in US hospitals.
